definitions.explanation: To go back to a previous location, state, or condition. This is intransitive - you yourself return.
For something to return to its original state or condition.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}に{戻|もど}りましょう。
{元|もと}の{場所|ばしょ}に{戻|もど}ってください。
examples.english: Please return to your original place.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}が{戻|もど}りました。
examples.english: My health has returned (I feel better).

notes: 戻る conjugates as a godan verb: 戻らない (negative), 戻って (te-form), 戻った (past). This is intransitive. The transitive counterpart is 戻す (もどす - to return something, to put back).
